part_A.alerts: notebook-16 stored alerts matched to each window catalog; exact McNemar per method pair, Holm within window and endpoint; M0 - M3 pre-onset catch-rate difference with calendar-month and 72-hour-cluster bootstraps (30000 draws)
part_A.crossover: pi* = (pre_A - pre_B) / ((pre_A - pre_B) - (in_A - in_B)), defined when the two differences have opposite signs
part_A.per_minute: notebook-22 decomposition on the minutes where all four scores are finite; one shared 500 x 7-day block bootstrap for all scores
part_A.reading_rule: At each window, the standard-AUC ordering of a pair is read as beyond sampling variation only if the 95% interval of the paired difference excludes 0; otherwise it is reported as not distinguishable.

part_B.bootstrap: moving blocks of 20 trading days over the test days, 400 draws (as in Le and Hoang)
part_B.data: FRED VIXCLS and NASDAQCOM, daily, 1990-01-02 to 2026-07-20; if FRED is unreachable, the CBOE VIX history (VIXCLS source) and Yahoo ^IXIC close; source and SHA-256 recorded
part_B.design: Le and Hoang (2026): stress = VIX >= 25; evaluate days with VIX < 25; positive if VIX >= 25 on any of the next h trading days; h in {1,3,5,10}; train 1990-2014, validation 2015-2017, test 2018-01-01..2026-07-20; days whose target window crosses a split edge dropped
part_B.features: market-only: VIX, 1-day VIX change, 5-day VIX mean, NASDAQ daily % return, its trailing 20-day standard deviation
part_B.frontier: false-alarm days per year = alert days with no onset in the next h days / test years; episode detected if any alert in the h days before onset; budgets [5, 10, 20, 40]

models.lasso: L1 logistic, C chosen on validation PR-AUC from [0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]

part_B.nasdaq_alignment: NASDAQ close carried forward at most 3 days onto VIX dates; 20-day standard deviation needs at least 15 returns (added after the first run, in which single missing NASDAQ days removed 20-day stretches of the test sample)
part_B.post_hoc_diagnostic: paired difference of within-1-point-bin AUC, selected model minus VIX level (added after the first run; does not replace the reading rule)
part_B.reading_rule: For each h: the selected model's onset skill is called not shown to exceed the VIX level if (i) the 95% interval of its test ROC-AUC minus the VIX-level ROC-AUC includes 0 or lies below 0 and (ii) its ROC-AUC within 1-point VIX bins has a 95% interval that includes 0.5. If the interval in (ii) lies above 0.5 the model is said to carry information beyond the VIX level. Every h is reported; nothing is selected.

runup.R1_quarter_way: VIX has covered at least a quarter of the distance from its trailing 20-day low to 25
runup.R2_20pct_above_low: VIX is at least 20% above its trailing 20-day low

part_B.runup_note: only positives are split, as in the paper decomposition; all three definitions reported, none selected
part_B.selection: per h by validation PR-AUC, then refit on 1990-2017 and scored once on test
part_B.within_regime: ROC-AUC over positive-negative pairs in the same 1-point VIX bin (primary) and the same test VIX decile (secondary)

title: Ranking reversal across crash windows (BTC dev) and a volatility-regime baseline for a daily VIX-onset design (exploratory)
